_classes.name: designation_no_actor gate drops real list-item duties under a 'shall have the following powers and duties' / 'responsibilities shall include' / 'shall (a)' lead-in
_classes.rule: dropped/*.json: rule=='designation_no_actor' and re.match(r'^(To [a-z]+|Advise|Work with|Serve as|Review and|Engage in|Assure|Provide|Require|Conduct|Determine|Furnish|Establish|Develop|Prepare|Maintain|[Cc]onsider|Implement|Divide|Eliminate|Identify)\b', quote) (335 designation_no_actor drops in total)

_classes.name: act_clause gate drops amended sunset sections of OTHER chapters (real extends_existing records)
_classes.rule: dropped/*.json: rule=='act_clause' and in the packet law text (deleted matter removed) the 600 chars before the quote match r'(section|subdivision|paragraph) [\w-]+ of (chapter|part) [\w-]+ of the laws of \d{4}[^.]*is (hereby )?amended'. Note: 0 of 139 act_clause drops match the law's own stored raw_clause.

_classes.name: list items under a 'shall' lead-in stored as power (powers-and-duties list, director-shall-promulgate list)
_classes.rule: kind=='power' and re.match(r'^(To )?(promulgate|furnish|conduct|determine|provide|require|establish)\b', quote, re.I); over-inclusive, true powers also match

_classes.name: one-time setup duty (rulemaking, appointment, signage installation) given deadline none instead of on_effective_date
_classes.rule: kind=='duty' and deadline_kind=='none' and ((recurrence=='one-time' and deliverable_type in ('rulemaking','designation or staffing')) or (deliverable_type=='signage or installation' and re.search('install', quote, re.I)))

_classes.name: benefit/amount sentences stored as duties (known entitlement class, recurrence)
_classes.rule: kind=='duty' and re.search(r'\b(rate|final average salary|allowances?|pensions?|interest|benefits?)\b[^.;]{0,160}\bshall be (calculated|continued|used|equal|one-half|allowed|increased|credited)', quote, re.I)

_classes.name: contents of a director's remedial directive stored with the directed agency ('said agency') as actor
silent record loss: obligation_id gaps with no stored or dropped record (parallel provision with identical quote)
_classes.rule: per matter_id, integers 1..max(obligation_id suffix) absent from both stored records and dropped/*.json

2009-S8314-02.quote: Advise and assist the Governor in formulating policies relating to workforce diversity and Minority and women's Business enterprises

2009-S8314-10.quote: The director may issue regulations on the construction of the terms in this definition.

2009-S8314-11.quote: The director of the division of minority and women-owned business development in the department of economic development is authorized and directed to recommission a statewide disparity study regarding the participation of minority and women-owned business enterprises in state contracts since the amendment of this article

2009-S8314-12.quote: is directed to transmit the disparity study to the governor and the legislature not later than February fifteenth, two thousand sixteen, and to post the study on the website of the department of economic development.

2009-S8314-13.quote: Each agency shall structure procurement procedures for contracts made directly or indirectly to Minority and women-owned Business enterprises, in accordance with the findings of the two thousand ten disparity study

2009-S8314-14.quote: The director shall ensure that each state agency has been provided with a copy of the two thousand ten disparity study.

2009-S8314-15.quote: Each agency shall develop and adopt agency-specific goals based on the findings of the two thousand ten disparity study.

2009-S8314-16.quote: The director shall promulgate Rules and regulations pursuant to the goals established in subdivision one of this section that provide measures and procedures to ensure that certified Minority and women-owned businesses shall be given the opportunity for maximum feasible participation in the performance of state contracts

2009-S8314-17.quote: Provide for the certification and decertification of Minority and women-owned Business enterprises for all agencies through a single process that meets applicable requirements

2009-S8314-18.quote: Require that each contract solicitation document accompanying each solicitation set forth the expected degree of Minority and women-owned Business Enterprise participation based, in part, on:

2009-S8314-19.quote: Require that each agency provide a current list of certified Minority Business enterprises to each prospective contractor

2009-S8314-20.quote: Allow a contractor that is a certified minority-owned or women-owned Business Enterprise to use the work it performs to meet requirements for use of certified minority-owned or women-owned Business enterprises as subcontractors

2009-S8314-23.quote: Require that an agency verify that Minority and women-owned business enterprises listed in a successful bid are actually participating to the extent listed in the project for which the bid was submitted

2009-S8314-24.quote: Provide for the collection of statistical data by each agency concerning actual Minority and women-owned Business Enterprise participation

2009-S8314-26.quote: In the implementation of this section, the contracting agency shall (a) consult the findings contained within the disparity study evidencing relevant industry specific availability of certified businesses;

2009-S8314-27.quote: Implement a Program that will enable the agency to evaluate each contract to determine the appropriateness of the goal pursuant to subdivision one of this section

2009-S8314-29.quote: Contracting agencies shall administer the rules and regulations promulgated by the director in a good faith effort to meet the maximum feasible portion of the agency's goals adopted pursuant to this article and the regulations of the director.

2009-S8314-30.quote: shall not allow any automatic waivers but shall allow a contractor to apply for a partial or total waiver of the minority and women-owned business enterprise participation requirements pursuant to subdivisions six and seven of this section

2009-S8314-31.quote: The director shall promulgate Rules and regulations setting forth measures and procedures to require all Contracting agencies, where practicable, feasible and appropriate, to assess the diversity practices of contractors submitting bids or proposals in connection with the award of a state contract.

2009-S8314-33.quote: Such reports shall be submitted periodically, but not less frequently than annually, as required by the director, and shall include such information as is necessary for the director to determine whether the Contracting agency and contractor have complied with the purposes of this article

2009-S8314-34.quote: The division of Minority and women's Business development shall issue an annual report which: (A) summarizes the report submitted by each Contracting agency pursuant to subdivision three of this section

2009-S8314-35.quote: Copies of the annual report shall be provided to the commissioner, the Governor, the comptroller, the temporary president of the Senate, the speaker of the Assembly, the Minority leader of the Senate, the Minority leader of the Assembly and shall also be made widely available to the public

2009-S8314-36.quote: Each agency shall include in its annual report to the Governor and legislature pursuant to section one hundred sixty-four of the executive law its annual goals for contracts with minority-owned and women-owned Business enterprises

2009-S8314-37.quote: Each Contracting agency that substantially fails to meet the goals supported by the disparity study, as defined by regulation of the director, shall be required to submit to the director a remedial action plan to remedy such failure.

2009-S8314-38.quote: the director shall provide written notice of such a finding, which shall be publicly available, and direct implementation of remedial actions to:

2009-S8314-43.quote: Upon a finding by the director that an agency has failed to take affirmative measures to implement the remedial plan and to follow any of the remedial actions set forth by the director, and in the absence of any objective progress towards the agency's goals, require some or all of the agency's procurement

2009-S8314-44.quote: the director shall refer the matter, within thirty days of the receipt of the complaint, to the division's hearing officers.

2009-S8314-45.quote: Upon conclusion of the administrative hearing, the hearing officer shall submit to the director his or her decision regarding the alleged violation of the contract and recommendations regarding the imposition of sanctions, fines or penalties.

2009-S8314-46.quote: The director, within ten days of receipt of the decision, shall file a determination of such matter and shall cause a copy of such determination along with a copy of this article to be served upon the contractor by personal service or by certified mail return receipt requested.

2009-S8314-47.quote: the contractor's willful and intentional disregard of the Minority and women-owned participation requirement included in the contract may include a determination that the contractor shall be ineligible to submit a bid to any Contracting agency or be awarded any such contract for a period not to exceed one year

2009-S8314-48.quote: if a contractor has previously been determined to be ineligible to submit a bid pursuant to this section, the penalties imposed for any subsequent violation, if such violation occurs within five years of the first violation, may include a determination that the contractor shall be ineligible

2009-S8314-49.quote: The division of Minority and women's Business development shall maintain a website listing all contractors that have been deemed ineligible to submit a bid pursuant to this section and the date after which each contractor shall once again become eligible to submit bids.

2009-S8314-50.quote: Every Contracting agency shall include a provision in its state contracts expressly providing that any contractor who willfully and intentionally fails to comply with the Minority and women-owned participation requirements of this article as set forth in such state contract shall be liable to the Contracting agency for liquidated or other appropriate damages
